{"predictors": [
  {"name": "Inventory Change Volatility", "construction": "Standard deviation of quarterly percentage changes in inventories over the past 3 years, calculated from Compustat quarterly data.", "rationale": "Firms with volatile inventory changes may face greater operational uncertainty, potentially leading to higher risk premia.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Relative Share Repurchase Intensity", "construction": "Total dollar value of shares repurchased over the past 12 months divided by average market capitalization over the same period, using Compustat and CRSP.", "rationale": "Aggressive repurchases may signal undervaluation or firm confidence not yet fully reflected in prices.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Short-Term Debt Growth", "construction": "Percentage growth in short-term debt over the past year, using Compustat annual balance sheet data.", "rationale": "Rapid increases in short-term debt could proxy for financing constraints or upcoming liquidity events, possibly demanding a return premium.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Intrayear Price Range Ratio", "construction": "Ratio of the highest to the lowest daily closing price within the past 12 months, from CRSP.", "rationale": "A wider range may reflect higher perceived uncertainty or volatility not fully compensated by standard risk measures.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "SG&A Expense Efficiency", "construction": "Sales-to-SG&A expense ratio averaged over the past 3 years, using Compustat annual data.", "rationale": "Efficient conversion of selling, general, and administrative expenses into sales may indicate superior management and future performance.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "R&D to Fixed Assets Ratio", "construction": "Total R&D expense (Compustat item XRD) divided by net property, plant, and equipment, measured at fiscal year end.", "rationale": "This ratio captures the intensity of innovation relative to physical capital, potentially identifying firms with greater growth opportunities.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Seasonal Sales Consistency", "construction": "Standard deviation of quarterly sales growth rates, seasonally adjusted, over the past 5 years from Compustat quarterly data.", "rationale": "More consistent sales may reflect predictability and lower risk, while investors may over-discount such firms.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Net Insider Trading Ratio", "construction": "Net insider purchases (shares bought minus sold by officers and directors) divided by total shares outstanding, aggregated over the past year from SEC Form 4 filings.", "rationale": "Persistent insider buying may indicate private information regarding undervaluation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Unrecognized Tax Benefits Accrual", "construction": "Year-over-year change in reserves for unrecognized tax benefits, scaled by total assets, from Compustat footnotes.", "rationale": "Growing reserves may signal either aggressive tax strategies or impending earnings adjustments, which could be mispriced by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Dividend Omission Indicator", "construction": "Indicator variable equal to one if a firm paid a quarterly dividend in the prior year but omitted it in the most recent quarter, using CRSP and Compustat.", "rationale": "Dividend omissions may be interpreted as distress, but subsequent overreaction by investors may create return opportunities.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
